title: Delegate: EDGCITIZEN
body:
Hello Edgeware Citzens,

       An Advocate for self sovereignty within a community. Since communities consist of their members. Edgeware will become a reflection of it’s citizens. Everyone’s perspective is valuable, feedback is optional. Communication is foundational for success. 

I have an apprehension of proposals from citizens that negate the opinions of other community members. This devalues citizenship and our overlooks that we’ve always been decentralized. Unity is a strength. The allowance of proposal critique is vital and appreciated. 


## 2 Parameters for voting

**Voting Principles** for Edgeware’s sustainability, please see the post below outlining my voting principles.
[https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/8478-voting-principles-perspective](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/8478-voting-principles-perspective)



**Personal opinion** is based on structure the proposal’s structure. I remain opposed to proposals with redundant fees, conflicts of interest or that place any fiscal responsibility upon Edgeware for voluntary contributor service or contribution.  I look for the value, impact, benefit to Edgeware or problem that it’s remedying to be outlined within the proposal.  I’ll review the presented proposal and vote in accordance.  

Onchain ID: **EDGCITIZEN**


Hey, this is Zovern. As many know, I began my citizenship as an investor, with plans to build applications.
